tldr: Buyers and officials at the first National Stevia Summit in Hyderabad said cultivation could start on 500 to 1,000 acres, expanding with market response.

beats.what: Sri Konda Laxman Telangana Horticultural University will run a stevia nursery at its Rajendranagar college.
beats.why: Demand for natural sweeteners is rising, opening scope in cultivation, extraction and processing.
beats.care: Adoption depends on planting material, water, costs and assured buyers, the report says.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The university suggested stevia as an intercrop in oil palm and mango plantations.
